For the locations in Dungeons, see MCD:Location. For other uses, see Location.

A location is a major area in Minecraft Dungeons II. Upon entering a location, a notification appears on the screen displaying its name. Heroes can seamlessly move between locations through the open world, and many locations contain sub-areas and minecart stations.
